question.text: In the following electron - dot structure, calculate the formal charge from left to right nitrogen atom; \(\ddot{\mathrm{N}}=\mathrm{N}=\ddot{\mathrm{N}}\)

solution.text:
Hints: Formal chargl= Number of electrons in
Valence shell \(-\left(\frac{1}{2} \times\right.\) numbers of electrons as bond pair + numbers of electrons as lone pair)
\(\begin{gathered}
1 \quad~~ 2 ~~\quad 3\\
: \ddot{\mathrm{N}}=\mathrm{N}=\ddot{\mathrm{N}}:
\end{gathered}\)
For \(\mathrm{N}_1 ~\&~ \mathrm{~N}_3\)
Formal charge \(=5-\left(\frac{4}{2}+4\right)=5-(6)=-1\)
For \(\mathrm{N}_2=5-\frac{1}{2} \times 8-0=5-4=+1\)
